name: riders-galaxy
description: Riders Galaxy E-commerce Portal - Full Stack Monorepo

scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.deploy: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path 'frontend\dist\*' -Destination '.' -Recurse -Force; if (-not (Test-Path '.nojekyll')) { New-Item -Path '.nojekyll' -ItemType File }"
